claims: Faroe Islands defeated San Marino 2-1 in a friendly international match
The match was held at Stadio Olimpico di Serravalle, San Marino
The match was tied 1-1 at halftime
Final score was San Marino 1-2 Faroe Islands
The match saw 3 goals total, as reported by ESPN

San Marino lineup (4-3-3): Edoardo Colombo; Filippo Fabbri, Michele Cevoli, Dante Carlos Rossi, Alessandro Tosi; Alessandro Golinucci, Lorenzo Capicchioni, Samuel Pancotti; Nicolas Giacopetti, Nicola Nanni, Lorenzo Lazzari, according to FotMob

Faroe Islands lineup (3-4-3): Mattias Lamhauge; Samuel Chukwudi, Gunnar Vatnhamar, Viljormur Davidsen; Joannes Kalsø Danielsen, Géza Dávid Turi, Jákup Andreasen, Martin Agnarsson; Árni Frederiksberg, Petur Knudsen, Hanus Sørensen, according to FotMob
